ns2:course.label: Project Design, II
ns2:course.description: (G E 343) Design of various engineering devices and systems. Teams of two to four students work toward the development of engineering solutions to problems supplied by industry. A midterm and final report summarize the work of the term for sponsor and faculty. Student team members may receive different grades. 2 undergraduate hours. No graduate credit. Prerequisite: GE 311, GE 331, and GE 424; concurrent enrollment in GE 494.
